answer: Repeat identities pay the same stake again, so farming accounts burns real capital. Each agent must stake a bonded deposit to a shared reputation bridge, and every new reputation slot starts behind a probation reef that caps its vote weight until it completes costly proof-of-work challenges. Peers also require a velvet-thread co-signature chain from three established participants, making mass registration expensive and traceable. In practice, qwe0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
